steps.title: Sketch half the shaft profile
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt to start a new part.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane (the front).
Line: draw half of the stepped outline above a horizontal centre line through the origin.
Format panel > Centerline: change the bottom line to a centre line, so Inventor dimensions diameters.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): diameters 30, 20 and 16; lengths 60, 40 and 28. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Revolve the shaft
actions: Click Revolve. Profile: the sketch. Axis: the centre line.

steps.title: Cut the thread undercut
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane. Draw a rectangle 3 wide at the start of the 16 mm diameter, from 13 mm diameter up past the outside.
Finish Sketch, then Revolve. Axis: the shaft centre line. Boolean: Cut. Click OK.

steps.title: Chamfer both ends
actions: Pick the outside edge at each end of the shaft. Click OK.

steps.title: Cut the keyway
actions: 3D Model tab > Work Features panel > Plane: Tangent to Surface and Parallel to Plane. Pick the 30 mm diameter and the XZ Plane.
Start 2D Sketch on that work plane.
Sketch tab > Create panel > Slot (Center to Center): centres 24 apart (30 long overall), 6 wide, centred 30 from the left end.
Finish Sketch. Extrude, Boolean: Cut, Distance 3.5 mm, into the shaft. Click OK.

steps.title: Add the M16 thread
actions: Click Thread and pick the 16 mm diameter face.
Specification: ISO Metric profile, size 16, designation M16x2. Untick Full Length and set 24 mm from the undercut.
Leave Display in Model ticked. Click OK.
steps.note: Inventor threads are cosmetic: the solid stays at the 16 mm major diameter and the drawing shows the thread by convention.
